# Path wildcard names may collide with identifiers the generated handler body
# references: imported packages (strconv, http), generated locals (td, buf),
# and captured variables (receiver, templates). The generator renames its
# locals so the handler still compiles, while request.PathValue keeps the
# original wildcard name.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /a/{strconv} A(ctx, strconv)"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /b/{td} B(ctx, td)"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /c/{receiver} C(ctx, receiver)"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /d/{templates} D(ctx, templates)"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /e/{http}/{buf} E(ctx, http, buf)"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"strconv"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) A(_ context.Context, n int) string { return strconv.Itoa(n * 2) }

func (T) B(_ context.Context, td string) string { return td }

func (T) C(_ context.Context, receiver string) string { return receiver }

func (T) D(_ context.Context, templates string) string { return templates }

func (T) E(_ context.Context, httpValue, buf string) string { return httpValue + "-" + buf }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func get(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, target string) string {
	t.Helper()
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET %s = %d, want %d", target, rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	return rec.Body.String()
}

func TestShadowedNames(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	for _, tt := range []struct{ target, want string }{
		{"/a/21", "42"},
		{"/b/inner-td", "inner-td"},
		{"/c/inner-receiver", "inner-receiver"},
		{"/d/inner-templates", "inner-templates"},
		{"/e/one/two", "one-two"},
	} {
		if got := get(t, mux, tt.target); got != tt.want {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", tt.target, got, tt.want)
		}
	}
}
